clauses.why: The verses say Bartimaeus sat begging and cried out as Jesus left; 'blind Bartimaeus cried out' is supported, but the name's cry is at 10:47 while 10:46 gives the place; wording simplified.
clauses.english: was where blind Bartimaeus cried out to Jesus as he left
clauses.ukr: там сліпий Вартимей кликав до Ісуса, коли Він виходив
clauses.deu: dort schrie der blinde Bartimäus zu Jesus, als er hinausging
clauses.spa: allí el ciego Bartimeo dio voces a Jesús cuando salía
